title: Protocol for establishing a coculture with fibroblasts and colorectal cancer organoids
protocol: Culture organoids in 15 μl domes consisting of 75% Matrigel and 25% tumor organoid (TORG) medium in 48 well plates.
Overlay each dome with 300 μL TORG medium.
Check organoids daily from Monday to Friday.
Change the medium or split organoids when necessary.
Passage organoid cultures every 3–7 days depending on growth and maintenance of Matrigel domes.
Split cells in the ratio of 1:2 to 1:4 based on density.
Pre-warm 48 well plates in the incubator at 37°C before use.
Do not remove medium from all wells at once to prevent organoids from drying or cooling.
Carefully discard medium in the wells without disrupting Matrigel domes.
Add 1 mL ice-cold PBS into 1 well.
Transfer 10% BSA solution from a low-binding tube into a new low protein binding tube with a fresh pipette tip.
Resuspend Matrigel dome with organoids using a BSA-coated pipette tip and PBS added in the previous step.
Pool maximum of 6 wells into the BSA-coated low protein binding tube.
Wash wells with 500 μL ice cold PBS and add to the organoid suspension.
Centrifuge the tube at 2,370 g at 23°C for 50 s.
Discard the supernatant with the dissolved Matrigel without disrupting the cell pellet.
Add 1 mL ice-cold PBS to the tube and resuspend the cell pellet using a BSA-coated pipette tip.
Centrifuge at 2,370 g at 23°C for 50 s.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL TrypLe with a Pipette 10–100 to enzymatically and mechanically digest organoids.
Incubate the cell pellet at 37°C roughly 5 min, resuspending by pipetting up and down every 1-2 min.
Incubate organoids up to 30 min to split them, checking regularly and resuspending gently.
Monitor the state of dissociation microscopically every 3 minutes using a Thermo Shaker at 1 g at 37°C if necessary.
Stop the "digestion" when organoids break into small cell clumps.
Add 1 ml advanced DMEM to stop digestion and mix gently.
Store organoids on ice for 15 min without moving the tube.
Carefully remove 100 μL–300 μL of supernatant without discarding organoids.
Spin down organoids at 2,370 g for 50 s and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend organoids in cold TORG medium carefully on ice.
Add Matrigel to the resuspended organoids, avoiding bubbles.
Mix gently to ensure no air bubbles are present in the Matrigel mixture.
Dispense a 15 μL dome in the middle of each well (use 48 well plates prewarmed at 37°C).
Incubate the Matrigel domes containing the organoids upside down for 15 min in the incubator at 37°C.
Overlay each dome with 300 μL TORG medium.
Split fibroblast when they are 100% confluent, usually at a ratio of 1:2.
Aspirate the medium and wash fibroblasts with 10 mL warm PBS.
Aspirate the PBS and add 1 mL 0.25% trypsin.
Move flask gently to cover all fibroblasts with trypsin.
Incubate the fibroblasts in the incubator for 5–10 min.
Check fibroblasts under microscope.
If the cells detach, resuspend the cells with 10 mL fibroblast medium.
Use a pipet boy to mix gently and transfer into a 15 mL polypropylene tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 180 g at 23°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL fibroblast medium.
Transfer 5 mL cell suspension to each T75 flask.
Top up to 15 mL by adding 10 mL fibroblast medium to each T75 flask.
Move flasks gently to distribute the cells evenly and let the cells attach in the incubator at 37°C.
Seed fibroblasts in 6 well plates or 384 well plates, depending on the readout method.
Split organoids and seed them on top of fibroblasts after 3 days of culture.
Treat cells for 2 days after 1 day of coculture.
Calculate 100,000 fibroblasts per well.
Resuspend fibroblasts in 3 mL fibroblast medium and 15 μL TGF-ß1 (stock 2 μg/mL) per 100,000 fibroblasts.
Seed the cells in a 6 well plate.
Cultivate for 3 days before conducting the next step.
Harvest organoids as described in step 2.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL fibroblast medium using BSA coated low-binding tips.
Transfer 20 μL cell suspension to the Fuchs-Rosenthal cell counting chamber and count the squares.
Calculate the cell number: cell number / counting chamber volume (here 3.2 μL) = cell number per μL
Calculate 10,000 organoids per well.
Resuspend organoids in 3 mL fibroblast medium per 10,000 organoids.
Aspirate the medium from the fibroblasts in the 6 wells.
Add 3 mL organoid cell suspension with 10,000 organoids per well.
Cultivate for one day.
Incubate for 2 days in the incubator until day 6.
Harvest and stain for FACS.
Prepare falcon® round-bottom polystyrene tubes.
Label falcon® round-bottom polystyrene tubes and coat tubes with BSA.
Harvest supernatant to ensure that cells loosely connected to the well will be analyzed as well.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 180 g at 23°C.
Discard the supernatant and store the tubes with the cell pellets on ice.
Wash the wells with PBS and aspirate PBS.
Add 300 μL of 0.25% trypsin to each well.
Check cells microscopically and resuspend every 5 min until cells detach.
Dissociate organoids into a single cell suspension.
Add 1 mL of fibroblast medium and transfer the mixture into falcon® round-bottom polystyrene tubes with the supernatant pellet (Step 5c.).
Centrifuge for 5 min at 180 g at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of 1× Annexin Binding Buffer (ABB) and centrifuge again for 5 min at 180 g at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Calculate 2 μL of EpCAM – bv421 antibody and 98 μL of 1× ABB for each sample.
Add 100 μL of the staining solution to the tubes.
Vortex and incubate on ice in the refrigerator for 30 min.
Add 1 mL of 1× ABB, vortex and centrifuge for 5 min at 180 g at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
For each sample prepare 300 μL staining solution with 1:200 AnnexinV-APC and 1:40 PI in 1× ABB.
Add 300 μL to each sample and incubate for 10 min on ice.
Measure cell viability using a flow cytometer.
Prepare the appropriate FACS compensation controls of unstained cells and single stained cells.
Calculate 2,000 fibroblasts per well for seeding.
Resuspend 8 μL fibroblast medium with 10 ng/mL TGF-ß1 per 2,000 fibroblasts.
Dispense 8 μL with 2,000 fibroblasts in each well of a 384 clear bottom plate.
Incubate the plates in the incubator at 37°C for three days.
Harvest and count organoids as described in Steps 5b.
Calculate 200 organoids per well.
Resuspend 200 organoids in 32 μL fibroblast medium.
Seed organoids on top of the fibroblasts.
Incubate for 1 day at 37°C.
Add treatment in a volume of 20 μL (optional).
If no treatment is added, add 20 μL of fibroblast medium.
Incubate for 2 days until day 6.
Thaw CellTiter Glo® reagent and incubate 30 min at 37°C.
Add 1:1 (v/v) CellTiter Glo® reagent to each well.
Incubate plate for 30 min in the incubator at 37°C.
Measure luminescence.
Exclude wells with bubbles or other inconsistencies.
Calculate viability of treated coculture relative to control.
